content.short: Aqua Protocol is a TON CDP project for minting over-collateralized AquaUSD against supported collateral.
content.description: Aqua Protocol is listed in the TON ecosystem as a collateralized debt position protocol. Its TON App listing describes AquaUSD as an over-collateralized stablecoin backed by liquid staking, liquidity pool, and real-world-asset collateral, while the linked domain currently redirects to the related Upscale trading product. The entry is kept as a TON DeFi listing, but users should verify the live app route before depositing funds. For builders, it is part of the TON infrastructure layer: APIs, data access, monitoring, compliance, indexing, or operational support.
